template.subject: Help with maintenance coordination at {firm_name}
template.body:
Hi,

I saw {firm_name} manages residential properties.

I built Callie after watching maintenance calls interrupt my mom’s family trips and wake her up at night. It’s an AI maintenance coordinator that handles tenant requests, coordinates vendors, follows up and confirms the work is done.

Would a 20-minute walkthrough be useful to see whether it could help your team?

Callie handles that coordination through completion—not just the initial conversation.

You can try a call with it at https://usecallie.com.
